description: False-color satellite image displaying an airport and its surrounding environment. Artificial surfaces such as runways, taxiways, and airport buildings appear in light cyan or white. The main runway is a long, dark grey strip centrally located. Adjacent to the airport, large areas of agricultural land and other vegetation are visible in varying shades of red, indicating high reflectance in the near-infrared spectrum. A winding river, appearing dark blue, flows across the lower portion of the image. Scattered smaller settlements and road networks are also discernible. The turquoise number "1240" is centrally annotated on the image, identifying the airport area as land cover class 1240, which corresponds to "Airports and associated land" according to Copernicus Land Monitoring Service (CLMS) guidelines.
